selection_rule: Exclude every recorded exclusion before selection. Sort eligible tasks by (sum of demo-input and query-input cells, task_id); split by rank into equal S/M/L thirds. Cross each tier with single/multi-query. Allocate requested tasks proportionally using integer largest remainders, ties by stratum name. Within each stratum rank sha256(UTF-8 seed + ':' + task_id), ties by task_id. Preserve every original query. Write selected tasks in task_id order. No model predictions or query answers enter selection.
length_measure: Demo and query input grid cell count; no demo-output cells or query outputs

scoring_reference_note: Reference used by earlier project scoring, not a claim every selected input matches it. After freezing both outputs, match full ordered demos and each query input. Report mismatches separately; do not choose gold versions by correctness.

frozen_policies.B4: Original V1 kgmon first two distinct grids
frozen_policies.R2: Retain original kgmon first grid; choose remaining distinct grid with minimum existing mean_aug_nll, ties in original kgmon order

limitations: Confirmation means unused for this round's R2 tuning, not model-unseen or unbiased hidden-score validation.
019 inferred the entire public source and historical aggregate scores exist; selected-query scoring exposure is not fully audited.
Exclusion metadata reflects recorded development/probe/reservation IDs and is not proof of an exhaustive historical task inspection audit.
Upstream public-eval validation/checkpoint selection and rule-derived training preclude an independent-blind-test claim.
Cell count stratification approximates input size, not tokenizer length, semantic difficulty or measured runtime.
Use a single generation pool and all frozen queries including missing predictions for B4/R2 comparison.
